title: Formal Conjectures (Solved Literature): Algebra, Analysis, Logic & Geometry
description: Twenty-five known-in-literature, unproved-in-Lean theorems across algebra, group theory, real & complex analysis, measure theory, logic, and geometry extracted verbatim from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures@5bd8bfb9 (Apache-2.0), including 7 FC100SolvedSet2 benchmarks (Erdős #114 lemniscate length, Chudnovsky's transcendence of Γ(1/3), Osin's Kourovka 8.8a, Pierce–Birkhoff dim 2, Shelah–Spencer 0–1 law, Green #54 Gaussian convex hull, conjugacy class sizes of S₃), plus Motzkin's Hilbert 17th Problem counterexample, Voronovskaja's theorem, Erdős–Volkmann Hausdorff dimension of additive subgroups, and Erdős's Lebesgue constant lower bound.
